title: Vysh
tagline: A data marketplace decentralized application built using the Skale network
description: A decentralized application deployed on Skale network to provide a data marketplace in which user will have control over their data (consider the health data which requires more control and security compared to other categories) and can sell the data to interested organizations Using NFTS
how_its_made: We built this project thinking about the data control which does not exist and need a proper solution to make it user controlled. We have used react to develop our frontend, node.js for the backend  and deployed Skale network and IPFS. We will be using Fleek to deploy our website with the domain from ENS service.
